The question form of kou "a friendly touch, a connection between people": asks permission to connect or pass, and draws attention before further speech, like the polite English "excuse me". Gesture: two taps, the other person first (catching their attention), then the speaker ("put your attention on me"). Kept separate from the apology paduu ek.

Past: osa, osu, os, osta, ostu, osen (perfect: osanun, osunun, osinun, ostanun, ostunun, osenun; story past: osaqel, osuqel, osqel, ostaqel, ostuqel, oseqel).
